scope: Independent read-only source/protocol-map review plus focused host tests with all compiler outputs in temporary directories. No source/freeze-file edits, firmware, real ring allocation, physical DMA, mappings, target execution, SSH, boot or deployment.

entry_gates.parent: Requires BCT_SHARED, not faulted, exact checked fake-accessor identity; explicit PCI14e4:4425. Stable parent window/shared metadata and caller serialization are assumptions, not discovered ownership.
entry_gates.readiness: PHY (word&0x8f)==0x0f, RUNbit0, LINK bits0/2/6 exactly1, then repeated PHY sample. Checked on entry, each endpoint read/write and immediately before ordinary buffer copy.
entry_gates.late_loss: Initial refusal does not mutate ring/buffer/device state. Reset/link loss during mutation stops later work and marks the in-flight ring faulted; no hidden hardware reset/restore/retry.

bounds_and_metadata.buffer: Depth2..16 and item4..64 multiple4, capacity exactly product<=1024, nonzero aligned64-bit label with overflow-safe extent. Label is serialized data, never dereferenced or claimed as bus address.
bounds_and_metadata.RAM: Every endpoint address 4-byte aligned and contained in BCT RAM window. uint32 overlap sums are safe under the <=4MiB RAM model.
bounds_and_metadata.guards: Protected shared120 bytes covers known fields through+116; info64 is an explicitly conservative policy, not asserted ABI size. Shared/info/mailbox/tail protected spans mutually disjoint; descriptor16 plus write/read index4 spans disjoint from protected and each other.
bounds_and_metadata.metadata: Exact shared flags/pointer snapshot, supported version5..7, DMA-index mode refused. No adoption of populated descriptor.

descriptor_and_index_width.descriptor: Requires four zero words; writes label low32, high32, then merged u16 depth/u16 item word; reads back all3 changed words. Word0 untouched.
descriptor_and_index_width.index: Only low16 used, value<depth; producer must equal cached owner. Serialized32-bit RMW preserves saved high16 and publication readback verifies low16. This cannot establish genuine16-bit MMIO or coherency safety on hardware.

order_full_wrap.order: Guard -> read indices -> leave-one-empty FULL check -> final pre-copy guard -> copy one exact-sized opaque item -> fresh guarded index read -> producer write -> readback -> cached producer/index_published update -> endpoint bell1 -> completed.
order_full_wrap.FULL: No buffer overwrite or device write, no implicit consumer progress.
order_full_wrap.wrap: next=(producer+1)%depth with depth>=2; old slot reused only under explicitly observed synthetic consumer progress.
order_full_wrap.doorbell: Normal BAR0+0x2140 or DAR BAR0+0x2a20, selected by shared DARbit31; endpoint notification only, not T8103 MSI configuration.

failure_and_lifetime.fault: Any I/O/verify failure or readiness error after inflight starts latches fault. Attempted writes may have applied; register_writes/index_write_attempts/bell_attempts distinguish attempts from confirmed index publication/completed submission.
failure_and_lifetime.retention: No rollback, descriptor clear, free or reset. Dirty/backing retained on failure; faulted APIs refuse further I/O.
failure_and_lifetime.close: Requires configured state and observed producer==consumer; marks logical closed/configured0 only. Descriptor/buffer retained. No real DMA completion, peer quiescence, IRQ drain or permission to free backing.
failure_and_lifetime.caller_contract: Ring/session/plan/buffer/input must have stable disjoint storage and one nonreentrant serialized caller; caller must initialize ring to its empty state and must not mutate copied plan/parent metadata while owned. The C callback/type guard is not a sandbox against forged pointers.

default_and_kernel.default_and_KERNEL_four_APIs: Return BCR_GATED with zero I/O, buffer changes and allocation; not merely runtime-unreachable fake logic.
default_and_kernel.negative_builds: BCR_FAKE_DEVICE+KERNEL and APB_FAKE_REGISTER_FILE compile refused; fake mode also requires checked host accessor build. No shared PHY/PMGR writes, GPIO152, SMC, firmware image/start or real hardware path.

ISC_protocol_map_crosscheck.use: Pinned ISC pcie.c as facts map only; no GPL source used. Existing source is a small original fake model, not imported Linux implementation.
ISC_protocol_map_crosscheck.not_admitted: Actual msgbuf item ABI/ring sizing, firmware version negotiation, coherent real allocation, DART/IOMapper admission, physical BAR ownership and T8103 MSI layout.

limits: Only host-model correctness under its explicit caller and fake-register assumptions was reviewed; passing tests do not establish hardware ownership or device access-width/barrier behavior.
Link/PHY sampling is instantaneous; no guard can promise readiness remains unchanged after a read. Failed physical MMIO containment is not supplied by this model.
The reference rings use real coherent backing and true16-bit accesses; this model deliberately does neither. Synthetic consumer updates and opaque items are not firmware execution.
Existing M1 read-only survey result remains guarded PHY_NOT_READY. No shared PHY/PMGR writer enable, P_PCIE_INIT, new packet or boot is authorized.
Root owns any future host end-to-end harness; this review added no competing model or integration implementation.
